title: Learn how pawns capture.
goal: Capture the opposing pawn on the square d5 with your pawn.
narration_seed: Pawns capture one square diagonally forward instead of moving straight ahead.
hints: Your pawn can capture diagonally from the square e4 to the square d5.
solution_text: Capture the opposing pawn by moving from the square e4 to the square d5.
success_text: You captured the opposing pawn on the square d5.
failure_text: Look for the diagonal capture from the square e4.
